listings.pitch_title: Rent a 5 ½ rooms loft in Horgen
listings.description_title: 5.5-room Light Filled Loft with Lake Zurich Views Single Level & Open
listings.description:
On the left shore of Lake Zürich in Horgen, on the first floor of an apartment building with lift, this loft apartment spreads across a single level with 195 m² of living space. What sets it apart belongs to it alone: the wide view over Horgen to the lake, through full-height windows and from the large balcony. 

The apartment is laid out so that openness and privacy sit side by side. From the entrance hall the way leads into the open living and dining area, where the cooking island forms the centre and the glazed front draws the eye outside; on warm evenings life moves out onto the balcony. Two quiet bedrooms lie on either side, the largest with its own dressing area, each wing with a bathroom within reach. Utility room, storage room and cellar keep daily life clear of everything that merely takes up space. 

**Key facts:**

• 5.5 rooms (4 bedrooms) 

• 195 m² living space on one level, plus cellar 

• Renovated to a premium standard in 2024 

• Wide view over Horgen to Lake Zürich 

• Balcony approx. 18.5 m², directly off the living and dining area 

• Stainless-steel cooking island; premium solid parquet and porcelain stoneware 

• Bespoke built-in wardrobe in the entrance hall, luxurious built-in cabinetry in the rooms, bedroom with dressing area 

• Two bathrooms on the living level: main bathroom with bathtub, double vanity and WC; shower room with shower, basin and WC 

• Utility room with washer and dryer tower and storage room within the apartment; private cellar 

• Two underground parking spaces, CHF 360 per month for both in addition to the rent 

• Gas heating, underfloor heating 

**Location:**

• Horgen station: swiftly reached (S2 and S8 to Zürich main station in around 20 minutes) 

• Bus stop: close by 

• A3 motorway, Horgen junction: around 3 km 

• Zürich city centre: around 20 minutes by car; Zürich Airport: around 30 minutes by car 

• Rotweg primary school: 145 m; kindergarten and secondary school in the neighbourhood 

• Neighbourhood shop: a few steps away; town centre with boutiques and shops within walking distance; doctors' practices around the station 

• Lake Zürich with promenade, lido and marina: immediately below, with walking paths along the water; fitness and tennis close at hand 

• Horgen tax rate: 90% 

This apartment suits anyone who wants to live on one level without giving up a sense of space: a family that needs four bedrooms and two bathrooms, or a couple with room to spare for guests, a home office and a dressing area. The lake is at the door, the city close enough for everyday life, and Horgen remains a place where evenings end quietly. 

To arrange a viewing of this apartment, please use the contact form.
